applicability.verification: Confirm the target instance version before applying this behavior operationally.

implementation.summary: The fixed method obtains the configured content channel and checks Edit authorization on that channel.

issue.reported_behavior: In Rock 19.1.8, the reporter found that channel-level and block-level Edit permission did not expose item management unless entity-level Content Channel Item Edit was also granted.

review.rationale: The official release note and immutable closing commit agree on both the authorization boundary and fixed version; the issue is retained only as reported affected-version context.

payload.summary: Rock 19.3 changes Content Channel Item List add and delete authorization from the Content Channel Item entity to the selected content channel.

retrieval_text: Rock 19.3 fixes the Content Channel Item List block so add and delete authorization uses Edit permission on the selected content channel instead of requiring Edit permission on the Content Channel Item entity; issue #6914 reported the affected behavior in Rock 19.1.8.
title: Content Channel Item List Authorization Fix in Rock 19.3
